headline: Accepted Chief Financial Officer resignation and approved Assistant Principal contract terms at Broad Rock Middle School
summary: The School Committee met in Executive Session to discuss the resignation of the Chief Financial Officer and contract terms for the Assistant Principal at Broad Rock Middle School. In open session, the committee accepted the resignation and approved the contract terms, both by 5-0 votes. Superintendent Podraza announced Corey Lennon as the new Assistant Principal.
decisions: Accepted the resignation of the Chief Financial Officer, 5-0.
Approved the terms of contract negotiation for the Assistant Principal at Broad Rock Middle School, 5-0.
